title: 3:07 — the coin on the nightstand
canon: On the nightstand sat the coin
Copper-colored, heavy for its size, cut with spirals and little hooked triangles his grandmother calls señales viejas, old signs
His grandmother gave it to him when he was twelve, after a fever
The coin ran warm — not body-warm, not radiator-warm, off like a plate somebody held a minute too long
He had pressed it to the back of his hand maybe a hundred times trying to prove he was imagining it
